newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah steady on month-end, U.S. rates.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah steady on month-end, U.S. rates.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was steady against the dollar in slow late trading on Wednesday, dealers said.
"The U.S. Fed's decision to keep interest rates unchanged and higher rupiah demand due to month-end factors have kept rupiah sentiment steady," one Japanese bank dealer said.
He said, however, the market remained quiet with volume seen relatively small and overseas operators mostly sidelined.
Spot rupiah was last at 2,317.80/18.25 compared with an opening of 2,318.25/18.75.
Dealers said demand for the local currency usually trends higher ahead of the month-end as firms were in need of more funds for tax and salary payments.

They said the ample rupiah liquidity on Wednesday failed to weaken sentiment on the local currency due to the month-end factors and the United States Federal Reserve's decision to keep rates unchanged.
Sentiment on the local currency was likely to remain steady on Thursday due to the month-end factors, they said.
Another bank dealer said the dollar-rupiah rate was expected to range between 2,318.0 and 2,319.0 on Thursday.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were quoted at 2,317.25/17.75 and 2,317.50/18.00 respectively.
Overnight swap was at 0.30/0.35 and tom/next at 0.35/0.40.
One-month swap was last at 15.00/15.25, two at 30.25/30.50, three at 46.00/46.50 and six at 94.50/95.50 points.
Bank Indonesia set its intervention rate at 2,313/2,505 and the conversion rate at 2,313/2,361 on Tuesday.
